goal: Diagnose checkout errors after a release

states.action: Deploy release 4.8 to production
states.text: After release 4.8 was deployed, checkout errors rose from 0.2 percent to 12 percent.

states.action: Flush the CDN cache to test whether caching caused the errors
states.text: The CDN cache was flushed, but checkout errors remained at 12 percent. The cache flush did not resolve the incident.

states.action: Roll back release 4.8 to release 4.7
states.text: After rollback to release 4.7, checkout errors returned to 0.2 percent within three minutes.
